title: 大水冲了龙王庙
summary: She is on her way out and the manager is already fawning at her back, as if the last half hour had never happened.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) has turned and is walking toward the LEFT door of the office; 钱经理 (S3) is still on the far side of the desk, half turned to follow her with his eyes; 周总监 (S6) stands at the desk; the crowd has pulled back to the walls of the doorway.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) leans out over the far side of the desk after her, shoulders rounded and both hands up, talking fast and soft in an oily nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 苏小姐。今天这是……大水冲了龙王庙。
[Shot 2] At 00:08.400, close on the back of 苏小满's (S1) head and shoulders: she keeps walking and does not turn her head a single degree.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, cut to the crowd at the LEFT doorway: every one of them leans and steps out of her way, clearing a path and looking anywhere but at her.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on 钱经理 (S3) left leaning over the desk with his hands still up and his sentence already useless. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A fast oily voice fading behind her, her own unhurried footsteps, the crowd shuffling apart, a cough somewhere.

title: 门口的小唐
summary: Silent beat: the witness cannot lift her head as the cleaner passes, and the director turns to the window and watches them drive away.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) is passing through the LEFT doorway; 小唐 (S4) is standing at the edge of the doorframe; 周总监 (S6) is still in the middle of the room, turning toward the window on the RIGHT.
[Shot 1] Close: 小唐 (S4) presses herself flat into the doorframe and drops her head as low as it will go, chin on her chest, hands folded in front of her apron, not looking up.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, 苏小满 (S1) walks past her without stopping and without looking at her.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, the camera follows 周总监 (S6) to the window on the RIGHT of frame; he lifts one slat of the venetian blind with two fingers and looks down into the street.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.200, his point of view down through the blinds: on the forecourt below, four men in dark suits fold into black cars, doors thud shut, and the cars pull away one after another. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: Quiet footsteps receding down the corridor, the blind slats ticking against glass, then from the street below the soft thud of car doors and engines.
music: A low sustained string note under the street view.

title: 什么来头
summary: The director speaks to the window without turning round, and the manager gives him nothing.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) stands at the window on the RIGHT of frame with two fingers under the blind; 钱经理 (S3) is still on the far side of the desk, a few steps back from it, where he leaned to watch 苏小满 (S1) go; the room is emptying, the crowd gone from the doorway.
[Shot 1] Medium from behind: 周总监 (S6) lets the blind fall back into place and speaks to the window without turning, in the same low level Mandarin: [Chinese] 小钱。这人，什么来头。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.200, reverse onto 钱经理 (S3): he wipes his forehead with the flat of his hand, swallows, and manages it in a small unsteady nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 不、不知道。
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, 周总监 (S6) turns from the window and looks at him for a long moment before answering, in that unhurried level voice: [Chinese] 不知道，才吓人。
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on 钱经理's (S3) face, sweat at his hairline, with nothing at all to say.
soundscape: Blind slats settling, a dry swallow, a low level voice in an emptying office, a computer fan somewhere, the clock.

title: 这楼姓陆
summary: He spells out the only fact that matters in the building, and it is not about the card at all.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) has turned away from the window on the RIGHT and stands facing the room; 钱经理 (S3) is in front of him, lower-left of frame; the office is nearly empty.
[Shot 1] Medium: 周总监 (S6) walks back to the desk and stands behind it, one hand flat on the dark wood, speaking in a slow level Mandarin, laying the facts out like a summary: [Chinese] 这楼姓陆。咱们公司，是趴在这楼里吃饭的。
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, closer on his face: no anger in it, only a tired professional assessment.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, cut to 钱经理 (S3) standing in the middle of the room, hands clasped in front of him, nodding a little too fast.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A slow level voice, the office now quiet enough for the ceiling lights and the clock, distant traffic through the glass.
music: A low horn note under the whole line.

title: 跟着担一回惊
summary: He says out loud what the visit cost them, and the manager just stands there taking it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) stands behind the desk with one hand on it; 钱经理 (S3) in front of him, lower-left; the office empty; the LEFT door standing open.
[Shot 1] Medium: 周总监 (S6) takes his hand off the desk, walks a slow half-circle behind it and speaks in the same level unhurried Mandarin, with a note of real fatigue under it: [Chinese] 这种人来一趟，咱们就得跟着担一回惊。
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, reverse onto 钱经理 (S3): he is nodding before the sentence is even finished.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, wide of the emptied office, the two men and the open door, the marble of the corridor bright beyond it.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A tired level voice, slow footsteps, the ceiling lights, the corridor outside carrying a faint lift bell and footsteps.

title: 她在一天，就是个雷
summary: The manager dares to ask about her, and the director gives his answer without hesitating.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) has walked back and stands behind the desk on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) stands in front of the desk on the lower-left of frame facing him; the black card is gone from the desktop, leaving the empty dark wood.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) leans in over the desk and asks it low and hopefully in a small nasal Mandarin, looking for a way out: [Chinese] 那……那位苏小满？
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, closer on 周总监 (S6); he does not need to think about it; he answers in a level, decided Mandarin, almost gently: [Chinese] 她在一天，就是个雷。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, insert on the empty desk surface: the marks in the dust where the keys, the pen and the card had been.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on 钱经理 (S3) taking that in.
soundscape: A low hopeful question, a flat decided answer, the office lights, the clock, a chair creaking.
music: A single low struck piano note under the decision.

title: 找个由头，让她走
summary: The order is given and taken in three sentences, quietly, with the door still open to the corridor.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) stands behind the desk on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) leans in toward him from the lower-left of frame in front of the desk; the office empty, the LEFT door still open to the corridor.
[Shot 1] Medium: 周总监 (S6) buttons his jacket, straightens his cuffs and gives the instruction in the same low level Mandarin, with no emphasis at all, which makes it worse: [Chinese] 找个由头，让她走。别声张。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.400, close on 钱经理 (S3): relief and fear at the same time; he straightens up fast and answers twice over in a quick nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 明白，明白。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.800, 周总监 (S6) walks toward the LEFT door, passes the manager without another word and goes out into the corridor.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on 钱经理 (S3) alone in the office, looking at the empty desk.
soundscape: A quiet instruction, two quick acknowledgements, unhurried footsteps leaving, then the empty office tone and the clock.
music: A low uneasy string note fading out.

title: 咽了口唾沫
summary: Silent closing beat of the office scene: he stands at the window and swallows hard.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 钱经理 (S3) is alone in the middle of the empty office; the LEFT door is open; the window with its venetian blinds is on the RIGHT of frame; the desk is clear.
[Shot 1] Medium: he crosses to the window on the RIGHT of frame and looks out through a gap in the blinds.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, close on his profile: his throat works as he swallows, once, hard.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, insert on the desk: the scuff marks in the dust, the keys and the ballpoint pen, and the empty space where the black card lay.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the camera drifts slowly back through the open LEFT door into the bright corridor, leaving him standing at the glass. Nobody speaks in this beat and every mouth stays shut.
soundscape: The ceiling lights, the clock, one hard swallow, a car passing in the street below, the corridor's open quiet.
music: The main theme returns quietly on low strings and holds through the cut.
